why: Adds note deletion end to end, a read cache, per-tag statistics in the Java service, and a nightly backup of notes to cloud storage.

g:@code: The Python backend, Java stats service, web page and a new backup script; gains deletion, a cache and tag counts.
g:@api: The OpenAPI description of every endpoint; adds delete and tag-count endpoints and renames one field.
g:@infra: Container image, local compose setup, Kubernetes deployment and new cloud backup storage.
g:app/: Stores notes in a JSON file and serves them over HTTP and the command line; now cached and deletable.
g:services/: A separate Java service that reads notes from the API and computes statistics; now counts notes per tag.
g:web/: The browser front end that lists notes; each note now has a delete button.
m:.github/workflows/ci.yml: Runs the tests on every push; now also runs a nightly backup job.
m:requirements.txt: Third-party libraries the backend needs; adds the AWS client library.
m:README.md: How to run the app; gains a section on deleting notes.
m:docs/runbook.txt: New step-by-step guide to restore notes from a nightly backup by pausing the API and copying the file back.
m:scripts/backup.sh: New shell script that copies the notes file to cloud storage under today's date.
c:api/openapi.yaml#Endpoints: Every HTTP operation the API promises; adds deleting a note and counting notes per tag.
c:api/openapi.yaml#Schemas: The fields a note has in API responses; the creation-date field was renamed.
m:Dockerfile: How the backend is packaged; moves to Python 3.13 and now runs as a non-admin user.
m:deploy/k8s.yaml: How the API runs in the cluster; now three copies of version 1.5.0, but privileged.
m:docker-compose.yml: Starts the API, web page and stats service together; the API gets a cache size setting.
m:infra/backup.tf: New Terraform for a backup bucket and its write permission; both are far too open.
c:app/api.py#NotesAPI: Turns web requests into note operations; adds a handler for deleting a note.
c:app/cache.py#LRUCache: New fixed-size memory cache that forgets the least recently used entry first.
m:app/cli.py: Manage notes from a terminal; adds an rm command.
c:app/models.py#Note: One note: a title, a body and tags.
c:app/service.py#NoteService: Core logic to add, list, search and now delete notes, with reads served from the cache.
c:app/store.py#JsonStore: Reads and writes all notes in one file; can now delete one and saves via a temporary file.
m:app/textutil.py: Makes URL-safe ids and splits text into words for search.
c:services/stats/src/main/java/com/notes: How the stats service fetches every note from the main API.
HTTP endpoints of the stats service; adds per-tag counts.
Computes numbers about notes; now counts how many notes carry each tag.
m:web/api.js: Functions the page uses to talk to the backend; adds a delete call.
c:web/app.js#NotesApp: Loads notes and redraws the list; now reacts to delete clicks.
m:web/render.js: Turns notes into HTML; each note now carries a delete button.
f:.github/workflows/ci.yml#on: Runs on every push and now also every night at 2 a.m.
f:.github/workflows/ci.yml#test: Checks out the code, sets up Python and runs the tests.
f:.github/workflows/ci.yml#backup: New: runs the backup script after the tests pass; uses an unpinned checkout action.
f:requirements.txt#boto3: New dependency for talking to AWS from Python.
f:README.md#Deleting notes: Explains the new delete command and that backups keep deleted notes for 30 days.
f:scripts/backup.sh#backup_notes: Copies the notes file to the backup bucket, named with today's date.
f:api/openapi.yaml#Endpoints.GET /notes: Returns all notes, optionally filtered by tag.
f:api/openapi.yaml#Endpoints.DELETE /not: New: removes a note by id; answers 204 when deleted and 404 when missing.
f:api/openapi.yaml#Endpoints.GET /stats/: New: how many notes use each tag, served by the Java stats service.
f:api/openapi.yaml#Schemas.Note: Fields of a note; created was renamed createdAt, which breaks existing clients.
f:Dockerfile#container image: Python 3.13 base, creates an app user and runs as it, then starts the app.
f:deploy/k8s.yaml#Deployment/notes-api: Runs the API image; now three replicas of version 1.5.0 in a privileged container.
f:deploy/k8s.yaml#Service/notes-api: Exposes the API deployment on port 80 inside the cluster.
f:docker-compose.yml#api: Builds the backend and opens port 8000; now sets the cache size to 256.
f:docker-compose.yml#web: Serves the front end with nginx.
f:docker-compose.yml#stats: Builds and runs the Java stats service.
f:infra/backup.tf#aws_s3_bucket.backups: New storage bucket for backups; set to public-read, so anyone can download the notes.
f:infra/backup.tf#aws_iam_policy.backup_: New policy for the backup job; allows every storage action on every resource.
f:infra/backup.tf#output.backup_bucket: Publishes the backup bucket's name for other tools.
f:app/api.py#NotesAPI.create: Creates a note from the request body.
f:app/api.py#NotesAPI.list: Returns notes, optionally for one tag.
f:app/api.py#NotesAPI.search: Returns notes that match the search words.
f:app/api.py#NotesAPI.delete: New: deletes the note and answers 204, or 404 if it did not exist.
f:app/cache.py#LRUCache.__init__: Sets the capacity and an empty ordered store.
f:app/cache.py#LRUCache.get: Returns a cached value and marks it recently used; nothing if missing.
f:app/cache.py#LRUCache.put: Saves a value and drops the oldest one when full.
f:app/cache.py#LRUCache.invalidate: Empties the cache so the next read reloads from storage.
f:app/cli.py#build_parser: Declares the command-line commands; adds rm with a note id.
f:app/cli.py#main: Dispatches the chosen command; rm now deletes a note.
f:app/service.py#NoteService.__init__: Connects storage and now creates a 256-entry cache.
f:app/service.py#NoteService.add_note: Saves a new note and now clears the cache so lists stay fresh.
f:app/service.py#NoteService.list_notes: Lists notes, now read through the cache.
f:app/service.py#NoteService.search: Finds notes that share a word with the query, now read through the cache.
f:app/service.py#NoteService.delete_note: New: removes a note from storage and clears the cache; reports whether it existed.
f:app/service.py#NoteService._all_notes: New: returns all notes from the cache, reading the file only on a miss.
f:app/service.py#NoteService.legacy_expo: Removed: wrote every note to a tab-separated file.
f:app/store.py#JsonStore.load: Loads every note from the JSON file.
f:app/store.py#JsonStore.save: Now writes a temporary file and swaps it in, so a crash cannot corrupt the notes.
f:app/store.py#JsonStore.delete: New: deletes one note from the file; false if it was not there.
f:app/store.py#JsonStore.all: Returns every stored note as a list.
f:app/textutil.py#tokenize: Breaks text into lowercase words for search.
f:services/stats/src/main/java/com/notes: Asks the main API for every note.
New: answers the tag-counts endpoint with counts per tag.
New: fetches all notes and tallies how many carry each tag.
f:web/api.js#deleteNote: New: asks the backend to delete a note; true when it answers 204.
f:web/app.js#NotesApp.constructor: Sets up the page and now listens for clicks on the list.
f:web/app.js#NotesApp.onClick: New: when a delete button is clicked, deletes the note and redraws.
f:web/app.js#NotesApp.draw: Renders the current notes into the page.
f:web/render.js#renderNote: Builds a note's HTML; now with its id and a delete button.
f:web/render.js#renderList: Builds the HTML for all notes.
m:app/models.py: Module-level helper that validates note titles before they are saved.
f:app/models.py#validate_title: Rejects empty titles and titles longer than 120 characters.

views.root: One change touched code, the API contract, infrastructure, the pipeline, dependencies and docs.
views.g:@code: Three code areas changed, plus a new backup script.
views.g:@api: The contract gains two endpoints and renames one field.
views.g:@infra: Packaging, local setup, the cluster and new cloud storage all changed.
views.m:.github/workflows/ci.yml: Tests still run on every push; a nightly backup job was added.
views.g:app/: Delete flows from the HTTP handler through the service to the file; reads now go through a cache.
views.g:services/: The Java service gains a per-tag count behind a new endpoint.
views.g:web/: Each note gets a delete button wired to a new API call.
views.m:infra/backup.tf: A public bucket and a wide-open write policy were added.
views.c:app/service.py#NoteService: Every read now goes through the cache; every write clears it.

risks.r1: Real issue: a branch can change under you; pin the checkout action to a release tag or commit.
risks.r2: Real issue: nothing in the API needs host access; remove privileged mode.
risks.r3: Real issue: backups contain every note, so a public-read bucket leaks them; make it private.
risks.r4: Real issue: the backup only uploads files; allow just the upload action.
risks.r5: Real issue: limit the policy to the backup bucket instead of every resource.
risks.r6: Real issue: any client reading created breaks; send both fields for one release or version the API.
risks.r7: Probably unneeded: the backup script uses the AWS command-line tool, not this library.

beats.b1: What the AI changed in the notes app: note deletion, a read cache, tag statistics, and a nightly cloud backup.
beats.b2: Users can now delete notes and see tag counts; a cache speeds up reads, and nightly backups protect the data.
beats.b3: Twenty files changed across six areas: code, the API contract, infrastructure, the build pipeline, dependencies and documentation.
beats.b4: In the code, the Python backend, the Java stats service and the web page changed, and a new backup script appeared.
beats.b5: On the web page, each note gets a delete button that calls a new delete function in the browser's API layer.
beats.b6: The Python backend gains a delete path from the HTTP handler down to file storage, and a cache in front of every read.
beats.b7: The Java stats service gains a new endpoint that counts how many notes carry each tag.
beats.b8: The API contract documents both new endpoints, and renames the note's creation date field, which breaks existing clients.
beats.b9: Infrastructure: the image moves to Python 3.13 as a non-admin user, Kubernetes runs three replicas, and Terraform adds a backup bucket.
beats.b10: Review these first: a privileged container, a public backup bucket, an over-broad storage policy, an unpinned CI action, and the renamed field.
beats.b11: Inside the note service, listing and searching now read through the cache, while adding and deleting clear it.
beats.b12: The new delete operation removes the note from storage, then clears the cache so nobody sees the deleted note.
beats.b13: It asks storage to delete by id; only when something was removed does it empty the cache, then it reports success.
beats.b14: In short: deletion works end to end and reads are cached, but fix the privileged pod and the public bucket before shipping.
